chapter: Reel IV retellings and New York pianists
title: Jelly Roll Morton at the Lafayette
summary: Hinton asks about Jelly Roll, and Whaley recalls him pacing in front of the Lafayette Theatre.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band

blocks.x: Who did you meet? Who was the first piano player you met around here? Did you know anything about Jelly Roll?
Oh, Jelly Roll -- I was trying to think about that; I met Jelly Roll up here at the theatre, you know?
He used to pace around in front of the Lafayette Theatre, and Jelly Roll Morton -- so I'll come up to that later.
